'''Control cables''' were a type of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] cable used in the construction of the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]].

==Description==
Evolving from the reins used in beast-drawn chariot and cart races that preceded [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]], control cables were made of durasteel and connected a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer's]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] to the [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. Long and flexible, they housed the wiring needed to connect the controls and the engines. While most Podracers incorporated the cables, a rare few pods had their engines mounted directly to the cockpit and did not require cables. The most fragile part of a Podracer, these durable cables were prone to snapping and breaking if strained too much.<ref name="CV">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2013)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']]</ref>
